fields.title: Radius scope of hot-day failure
fields.finding: No sampled radius 10/12/15/20/30 m floats on the declared 10% hot profile, even with all four endpoints. This does not prove impossibility at every radius or under every pressure/profile assumption.
fields.missing_evidence: A separately defined expanded-size or revised-design study if required.
